adapter_name.title: Name
adapter_name.description: Provide a unique name for this adapter instance. Example: Bedrock-1

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name. Refer to [Bedrock's documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-supported.html) for the list of available models. Models served by the Bedrock Mantle endpoint (the OpenAI GPT-5.x and GPT-OSS, Google Gemma 4 and xAI Grok families) are detected and routed there automatically — enter the bare model ID, e.g. `openai.gpt-5.6-terra`, not a `us.`/`global.` cross-Region inference profile ID.

model_id.title: Application Inference Profile ARN
model_id.description: Optional ARN for Application Inference Profile for cost tracking. Example: arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:000000000000:application-inference-profile/xxxx. Not supported for models served by Bedrock Mantle (including GPT-5.x, GPT-OSS, Gemma 4 and Grok) — ignored with a warning.

auth_type.title: Authentication Type
enumNames: IAM Role / Instance Profile (on-prem AWS only)
auth_type.description: Choose **Access Keys** for any deployment (provide your AWS Access Key ID and Secret). Choose **IAM Role / Instance Profile** only when Unstract is hosted on AWS infrastructure that already has ambient credentials — for example EKS pods with IRSA, ECS tasks with a task role, or EC2 instances with an instance profile. Choose **Bedrock API Key (Bearer Token)** to authenticate with an AWS Bedrock API key (`AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`). The token is region-scoped — ensure the AWS Region below matches the key's region.

aws_profile_name.title: AWS Profile Name
aws_profile_name.description: AWS SSO profile name for authentication. Use this instead of access keys when using AWS SSO. Example: dev-profile

region_name.title: AWS Region Name
region_name.description: Provide the AWS Region name where the service is running. Eg. us-east-1

enable_thinking.title: Enable Extended Thinking
enable_thinking.description: Enhance reasoning for complex tasks. For Claude models this enables extended thinking with the token budget below. For GPT-5.x, GPT-OSS and Nova 2 models it enables the model's own reasoning at medium effort; the budget below does not apply. Models without reasoning support gain no reasoning, but note this setting pins the sampling temperature to 1 for **every** Bedrock model, so leave it off unless you want that.

guardrail_identifier.title: Bedrock Guardrail Identifier
guardrail_identifier.description: Optional. Apply an [AWS Bedrock Guardrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/guardrails.html) to moderate prompts and completions. Provide the guardrail ID (e.g. `ff6ujrregl1q`). Leave blank to disable. **Not supported for models served by Bedrock Mantle** (including GPT-5.x, GPT-OSS, Gemma 4 and Grok) — the Mantle endpoint has no guardrail field, so the setting is ignored with a warning and no moderation is applied.

guardrail_version.title: Bedrock Guardrail Version
guardrail_version.description: Version of the guardrail to apply. Use `DRAFT` for the working draft or a numeric version like `1`. Required when `Bedrock Guardrail Identifier` is set.

guardrail_trace.title: Bedrock Guardrail Trace
guardrail_trace.description: Enable to include guardrail trace info in the response (useful for debugging which rule was triggered).

max_tokens.title: Maximum Output Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens to limit LLM replies, the maximum possible differs from model to model.

max_retries.title: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt when a request fails.

aws_access_key_id.title: AWS Access Key ID
aws_access_key_id.description: Provide your AWS Access Key ID.

aws_secret_access_key.title: AWS Secret Access Key
aws_secret_access_key.description: Provide your AWS Secret Access Key.

aws_bearer_token.title: Bedrock API Key
aws_bearer_token.description: Paste the Bedrock API key (bearer token) issued for your AWS account. See AWS docs on `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`.

budget_tokens.title: Thinking Budget Tokens (Claude only)
budget_tokens.description: Sets the max tokens for Claude's internal reasoning when extended thinking is enabled. Ignored by non-Claude models, which reason at a fixed effort instead.
